summary: Deepgram Pay As You Go grants $200 in signup credits with no credit card and no expiration. The earlier Flux TTS free promo (through September 14, 2026) has ended: Flux TTS is now billed at $0.0450/1k characters pay-as-you-go, with a 'Buy Flux TTS, get matching credits' promo adding $1 in credits per $1 spent, up to $500.
claim_steps: Click Sign Up Free at deepgram.com/pricing (no credit card required).
Create a console account and an API key.
Use the $200 credit on STT, TTS, and Voice Agent APIs (credits do not expire).
